message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ 'main' ]
    paths:
      - '**.go'
      - '**.mod'
      - '**.wasm'
      - '**.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ 'main' ]
    paths:
      - '**.go'
      - '**.mod'
      - '**.wasm'
      - '**.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
      with: { go-version: stable }

    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

    - name: Format
      run: gofmt -s -w . && git diff --exit-code
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'

    - name: Tidy
      run: go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code

    - name: Download
      run: go mod download

    - name: Verify
      run: go mod verify

    - name: Vet
      run: go vet ./...

    - name: Build
      run: go build ./...

    - name: Test
      run: go test ./... -bench . -benchtime=1x

    - name: Test BSD locks
      run: go test -tags sqlite3_flock ./...
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'

    - name: Test dot locks
      run: go test -tags sqlite3_dotlk ./...
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'

    - name: Test modules
      shell: bash
      run: |
        go work init .
        go work use -r gormlite
        go test ./gormlite

    - name: Test GORM
      shell: bash
      run: gormlite/test.sh
      if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'

    - name: Collect coverage
      run: |
        go get -tool github.com/dave/courtney@v0.5.1
        go tool courtney
      if: |
        github.event_name == 'push' &&
        matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'

    - uses: ncruces/go-coverage-report@v0
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        coverage-file: coverage.out
        chart: true
        amend: true
      if: |
        github.event_name == 'push' &&
        matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'

  test-cross:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - name: freebsd
            version: '15.1'
          - name: netbsd
            version: '11.0'
          - name: openbsd
            version: '8.0'
            tflags: '-test.short'
          - name: illumos
            action: omnios
            version: 'r151058'
            tflags: '-test.short'
          - name: freebsd
            arch: arm64
            version: '15.1'
            tflags: '-test.short'
          - name: netbsd
            arch: arm64
            version: '11.0'
            tflags: '-test.short'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Build
      env:
        GOOS: ${{ matrix.os.name }}
        GOARCH: ${{ matrix.os.arch }}
        TESTFLAGS: ${{ matrix.os.tflags }}
      run: .github/workflows/build-test.sh

    - uses: cross-platform-actions/action@v1.7.0
      with:
        operating_system: ${{ matrix.os.action || matrix.os.name }}
        architecture: ${{ matrix.os.arch }}
        version: ${{ matrix.os.version }}
        shell: bash
        sync_files: runner-to-vm

    - name: Test
      shell: cpa.sh {0}
      run: . ./test.sh

  test-vm:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - name: dragonfly
            action: 'vmactions/dragonflybsd-vm@v1'
            tflags: '-test.short'
          - name: solaris
            action: 'vmactions/solaris-vm@v1'
            bflags: '-tags sqlite3_dotlk'
            tflags: '-test.short'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Build
      env:
        GOOS: ${{ matrix.os.name }}
        BUILDFLAGS: ${{ matrix.os.bflags }}
        TESTFLAGS:  ${{ matrix.os.tflags }}
        VMACTIONS:  ${{ matrix.os.action }}
      run: .github/workflows/build-test.sh

    - name: Test
      uses: ./.github/actions/vmactions

  test-wasip1:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test

    steps:
    - uses: bytecodealliance/actions/wasmtime/setup@v1
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
      with: { go-version: stable }

    - name: Setup
      run: echo "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

    - name: Test wasmtime
      env:
        GOOS: wasip1
        GOARCH: wasm
        GOWASIRUNTIME: wasmtime
        GOWASIRUNTIMEARGS: '--env CI=true --optimize opt-level=0'
      run: go test -short -tags sqlite3_dotlk -skip Example ./...

  test-qemu:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test

    steps:
    - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v4
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
      with: { go-version: stable }

    - name: Test 32-bit
      run: GOARCH=386 go test ./...

    - name: Test loong64
      run: GOARCH=loong64 go test -short ./...

    - name: Test riscv64
      run: GOARCH=riscv64 go test -short ./...

    - name: Test ppc64le
      run: GOARCH=ppc64le go test -short ./...

    - name: Test s390x
      run: GOARCH=s390x go test -short ./...

  test-linux-arm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: test

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
      with: { go-version: stable }

    - name: Test
      run: go test ./...

    - name: Test 32-bit
      run: GOARCH=arm GOARM=7 go test ./...

  test-os-other:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [macos-15-intel, windows-11-arm]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: test

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
      with: { go-version: stable }

    - name: Test
      run: go test ./...

  test-linux-other:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04-riscv, ubuntu-24.04-s390x, ubuntu-24.04-ppc64le-p10]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: test-qemu

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Test
      run: go test -short ./...",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Go module (go.mod/go.sum present) whose CI repeatedly fetches dependencies across many matrix jobs and runner OSes. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE experiment (batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) measured adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on runner.os plus hashFiles('go.mod','go.sum') before go mod download, with 6.06% elapsed savings and all checks still passing. Preconditions hold: repeated dependency fetching is measurable from CI history, and cache inputs include the lockfile and runner environment. No equivalent cache exists in the workflow, and the change only adds a restore step before existing go mod commands, preserving every build/test check and all permissions unchanged.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ 'main' ]
    paths:
      - '**.go'
      - '**.mod'
      - '**.wasm'
      - '**.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ 'main' ]
    paths:
      - '**.go'
      - '**.mod'
      - '**.wasm'
      - '**.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
      with: { go-version: stable }

    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

    - name: Format
      run: gofmt -s -w . && git diff --exit-code
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'

    - name: Tidy
      run: go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code

    - name: Download
      run: go mod download

    - name: Verify
      run: go mod verify

    - name: Vet
      run: go vet ./...

    - name: Build
      run: go build ./...

    - name: Test
      run: go test ./... -bench . -benchtime=1x

    - name: Test BSD locks
      run: go test -tags sqlite3_flock ./...
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'

    - name: Test dot locks
      run: go test -tags sqlite3_dotlk ./...
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'

    - name: Test modules
      shell: bash
      run: |
        go work init .
        go work use -r gormlite
        go test ./gormlite

    - name: Test GORM
      shell: bash
      run: gormlite/test.sh
      if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'

    - name: Collect coverage

        go get -tool github.com/dave/courtney@v0.5.1

      if: |
        github.event_name == 'push' &&
        matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'

      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        coverage-file: coverage.out
        chart: true
        amend: true
